lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits along the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a distinctive rectilinear coordinate system on the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a high-contrast vertical gradient with specular highlights on the superior edge and deep shadowing on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct semi-circular notch or loss of tissue on the posterior trailing edge of the visible pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a dark, slender remora swimming in close proximity to the ventral surface; high-contrast caustic network patterns from surface light refraction projected onto the anterior-dorsal region.
